rows.sub: Logo in two spots on 2027 guernseys

slides.label: The step up
slides.title: From trial season to top slot

slides.label: The fit
slides.title: Oil brand, now in team sport

caption:
Penrite went from Major Partner to principal at Melbourne in a year.

The oil brand joined the Demons ahead of 2026, added the AFLW side later in the year, and now takes the top slot across both programs for two years. Its logo lands in two spots on the 2027 guernseys, and it picks up the Walk to the 'G for FightMND. No fee was disclosed.

It also sits across Supercars and the Perth Bears. Penrite is a motorsport brand building a footy and league portfolio.
